from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from decimal import Decimal
from djmoney.money import Money
from .models import CommercialInvoice

class InvoiceFXRateLockView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, invoice_uuid):
        # Restrict rate adjustment to invoices issued by the user's organization
        invoice = CommercialInvoice.objects.filter(
            uuid=invoice_uuid,
            issuer_organization=request.user.organization
        ).first()
        if not invoice:
            return Response({"error": "Invoice not found or permission denied"}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        # Use verified rate from central treasury engine rather than unvalidated user input
        official_rate = invoice.get_verified_treasury_fx_rate(invoice.target_currency)
        invoice.applied_fx_rate = official_rate
        invoice.converted_total = Money(invoice.base_amount.amount * official_rate, invoice.target_currency)
        invoice.save(update_fields=["applied_fx_rate", "converted_total"])
        return Response({"status": "FX rate locked", "total": str(invoice.converted_total)})
